body.intent: Agents in runs stop running the full test suite locally: builders, verifiers, review checks, critics and fixers run only the tests of the packages and scripts their change touches (scoped go test with -trimpath, the affected testscripts, make self-check), and no step runs make check/make test or a bare go test ./... — the PR's GitHub CI runs the full suite before every merge and the ship workflow already waits for it. Owner, 2026-11-04: "Yes the test suites make sense, since we're going to run full CI anyway on GitHub before merge." (context: the VM's host CPU is over-committed, ~35% steal; every agent ran a full suite). Update the built-in workflows' role prompts, the rhiza-build/rhiza-review skills and guide topics, and CLAUDE.md's guidance, and keep the leaf acceptance checks scoped
